mapper.select: SELECT id, role_code, name, description, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM sim_role ORDER BY role_code

SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.name, r.description, r.revision, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sim_role r INNER JOIN sim_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sim_permission p INNER JOIN sim_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sim_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
